content: Applicability of GlobalTimeDomain . globalTimeDomain- Property The defined properties at GlobalTimeDomain . globalTimeDomain- Property may be defined individually per GlobalTimeDomain . This allows to define different value sets for each GlobalTimeDomain and any of the sub-domains.
